package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for http_handler_without_csrf_protection: POST/PUT/DELETE handler registration without evidence of CSRF token middleware
// fixture polarity: positive; family: security; severity: warning.
func transferHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		http.Error(w, "method not allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
		return
	}
	amount := r.FormValue("amount")
	to := r.FormValue("to_account")
	if amount == "" || to == "" {
		http.Error(w, "missing fields", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusAccepted)
	w.Write([]byte(`{"status":"transfer initiated"}`))
}
